scanNote:
WORKBOOK 24-BET. Unit 6 'Birds of a Feather...' — lug'at.

4b-mashqda 11 ta raqamlangan surat bor. Hammasi skaner bilan tekshirildi va TO'G'RI:
  1 crocodile, 2 duck, 3 dolphin, 4 penguin, 5 ladybird, 6 parrot, 7 fly, 8 snake, 9 butterfly, 10 cow, 11 lion.

Qolgan mashqlar ham TO'G'RI:
  1-mashq: fins, a mane, a long tail, skin, legs, claws, whiskers, a trunk.
  2-mashq: eggs, warm, have, seas, black, play, feathers, claws, funny, smile.
  3-mashq: live, strong, weigh, feed, easily, friendly, groups, world, kittens/puppies.
  4a: 1=c insects, 2=d mammals, 3=a reptiles, 4=b birds.

⚠ QIZIQ ZIDDIYAT: 4a-mashqning 1-ta'rifida hasharotlar 'usually TWO PAIRS of wings' (odatda ikki juft qanot) deyilgan. Lekin 4b-mashqning 7-rasmidagi PAShShA (a fly) — atigi BIR juft qanotli! Pashshalar turkumi lotincha 'Diptera' deb ataladi, ya'ni 'ikki qanotli'. Kitob 'usually' (odatda) so'zini shuning uchun qo'ygan.

⚠ 'LADYBIRD' — BRITANChA so'z (5-rasm). Amerikachada 'a ladybug'. Kitob britancha variantni ishlatgan.

⚠ 3-mashqning 9-bandida IKKITA bo'shliq bor: 'Cats have KITTENS and dogs have PUPPIES.' Bolalarning nomi alohida so'z bo'ladi: cat→kitten, dog→puppy, cow→calf, horse→foal.

exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir hayvonda QAYSI tana qismi borligini eslang.

  fins ....... suzgichlar (baliq, delfin)
  feet ....... oyoq kaftlari
  feathers ... patlar (faqat qushlarda)
  a mane ..... yol (sher, ot)
  a beak ..... tumshuq (faqat qushlarda)
  a tail ..... dum
  skin ....... teri (junsiz)
  fur ........ jun
  legs ....... oyoqlar
  ears ....... quloqlar
  paws ....... panjalar (mushuksimon, it)
  claws ...... tirnoqlar (yirtqich qush, mushuksimon)
  wings ...... qanotlar
  whiskers ... mo'ylovlar (mushuk, yo'lbars)
  arms ....... qo'llar (odam, maymun)
  a trunk .... xartum (faqat filda)

items.whyUz: Delfin suvda yashaydi → SUZGICHLARI bor. Oyog'i YO'Q (Coursebook 40-bet).
Sher — sutemizuvchi, pati bo'lmaydi. Erkak sherda YOL (a mane) bor.

Sichqon — sutemizuvchi, tumshug'i (beak) yo'q. UZUN DUMI bor.
'mice' — 'mouse' ning ko'pligi.

Akula — baliq, juni yo'q. Kulrang TERISI bor (delfin kabi).
'a shark' = akula.

Tuyaning uzun OYOQLARI bor — cho'lda yurish uchun.
Quloqlari esa kichkina. 'a camel' = tuya.

Burgut — qush. Qushda 'paws' (panja) BO'LMAYDI, 'claws' (tirnoq) bo'ladi.
Coursebook 41-betda 'sharp claws' berilgan edi.
Mushuk ucha olmaydi — qanoti yo'q. MO'YLOVLARI bor (yo'lbars kabi).

Filda qo'l yo'q — XARTUM (a trunk) bor. U qo'l vazifasini bajaradi.
Coursebook 43-betda: 'How long is its trunk?'

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct word from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: warm, seas, play, claws, smile, eggs, have,
         black, feathers, funny

Barcha gaplar Coursebook 40–42-betlardagi matnlardan olingan.

QAYSI SO'Z QAYERGA — MANTIQ:
  'lay ......'         → tuxum (eggs)
  'to keep them .....' → issiq (warm)
  '..... babies'       → fe'l kerak (have)
  'live in warm .....' → dengizlar (seas)
  '..... and white'    → rang (black)
  'learn how to .....' → fe'l (play)
  'thick .....'        → patlar (feathers)
  'very sharp .....'   → tirnoqlar (claws)
  'look .....'         → sifat (funny)
  'a big .....'        → tabassum (smile)

items.whyUz:
'lay eggs' = tuxum qo'ymoq — o'zgarmas birikma (Coursebook 40-bet).
'both' = ikkalasi ham.

items.textEn: 2  Grey seals have got thick fur to keep them ............ .
items.whyUz:
'keep somebody warm' = issiq saqlamoq (Coursebook 40-betdagi pingvin matni).
'a seal' = tyulen.

items.textEn: 3  Mammals ............ babies and feed their young on milk.
items.whyUz: 'have babies' = bola tug'moq. Ko'plik ega → HAVE ('has' XATO).

'in warm seas' = iliq dengizlarda (Coursebook 40-betdagi delfin matni).
'sea' → ko'plikda 'seas'.

items.textEn: 5  Zebras have got ............ and white stripes.
items.whyUz:
Zebra QORA va oq chiziqli (Coursebook 44-betdagi D rasm).
'black and white' — tartib o'zgarmaydi.

items.textEn: 6  Dolphins can easily learn how to ............ games.
items.whyUz:
'play games' = o'yin o'ynamoq (Coursebook 40-betdagi delfin matni).
'how to' dan keyin fe'l ASOS shaklida.
'thick feathers' = qalin patlar (Coursebook 40-betdagi pingvin matni).
'sharp claws' = o'tkir tirnoqlar (Coursebook 42-betdagi koala matni).
'look funny' = kulgili ko'rinmoq (Coursebook 40-betdagi pingvin matni).
'a big smile' = katta tabassum (Coursebook 40-betdagi delfin matni).

exercises.instructionEn: Use the words from the list below to fill in the gaps.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: kittens, feed, friendly, live, weigh, puppies,
         groups, strong, easily, world

DIQQAT — 9-band IKKI bo'shliqli:
  'Cats have ...... and dogs have ...... .'
  Mushukning bolasi va itning bolasi (Coursebook 42-bet).

items.whyUz: 'live IN water'. 'fish' ko'plikda ham 'fish' → fe'lga -s QO'SHILMAYDI.
'strong back legs' = kuchli orqa oyoqlar (Coursebook 43-betdagi kenguru matni).

'weigh about twenty kilos' (Coursebook 40-bet).
DIQQAT: 'are weigh' XATO — 'be' ishlatilmaydi.

'feed somebody ON milk' = sut bilan boqmoq.
'young' bu yerda OT — hayvonning bolasi.

items.textEn: 5  Parrots can learn how to talk ............ .
items.whyUz:
'easily' = osonlik bilan (Coursebook 40-bet: 'can easily learn').
Bu RAVISH, chunki fe'lni ('talk') tavsiflaydi.

'friendly TO somebody' = kimgadir do'stona (Coursebook 40-bet).
'are' dan keyin SIFAT keladi.
'live in small groups' = kichik guruhlarda (Coursebook 40-bet).

items.textEn: 8  Snakes live in many different parts of the ............ .
items.whyUz:
'parts of the world' = dunyo qismlari (Coursebook 40-bet).
DIQQAT: 'the' shart — the world.

Mushukning bolasi — KITTENS, itning bolasi — PUPPIES.
Har birining alohida so'zi bor (Coursebook 42-betdagi 10-mashq).

exercises.instructionEn: Match the definitions with the correct kind of animal.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT GURUH VA ULARNING BELGILARI:

  insects (hasharotlar)
     kichik jonzot, OLTI oyoq, odatda ikki juft qanot
     misol: kapalak, chivin, xonqizi

  mammals (sutemizuvchilar)
     bola tug'adi, sut bilan boqadi
     misol: delfin, sher, sigir, koala

  reptiles (sudralib yuruvchilar)
     qanoti yo'q, tuxum qo'yadi, ba'zilari xavfli
     misol: ilon, timsoh, kaltakesak

  birds (qushlar)
     pat, IKKI qanot, IKKI oyoq; tuxum qo'yadi, ucha oladi
     misol: to'tiqush, o'rdak, burgut
     (pingvin — istisno: ucha olmaydi)

⚠ QIZIQ ZIDDIYAT — PAShShA:

  1-ta'rifda hasharotlar 'usually TWO
  PAIRS of wings' (odatda IKKI JUFT
  qanot) deyilgan.

  ⚠ Lekin 4b-mashqning 7-rasmidagi
  PAShShA (a fly) — atigi BIR JUFT
  qanotli!

  ⚠ Pashshalar turkumi lotincha
  'DIPTERA' deb ataladi — 'ikki
  qanotli' degani.

  ⚠ Kitob 'USUALLY' (odatda) so'zini
  aynan shuning uchun qo'ygan: qoida
  hamma hasharotga to'g'ri kelmaydi.

pairs.left: 1  They are small creatures. They have got six legs and usually two pairs of wings.
pairs.leftUz: Ular kichik jonzotlar. Oltita oyog'i va odatda ikki juft qanoti bor.
pairs.whyUz:
OLTI OYOQ — hasharotning eng aniq belgisi.
'a creature' = jonzot. 'a pair' = juft.

pairs.left: 2  They have babies and they feed their young on milk.
pairs.leftUz: Ular bola tug'adi va bolalarini sut bilan boqadi.

pairs.left: 3  They haven't got wings. They lay eggs. Some of them are dangerous.
pairs.leftUz: Ularning qanoti yo'q. Tuxum qo'yadi. Ba'zilari xavfli.
pairs.whyUz:
Qanot YO'Q + tuxum qo'yadi + ba'zilari xavfli (zaharli ilon, timsoh).
'dangerous' = xavfli.

pairs.left: 4  They have got feathers, two wings and two legs. They lay eggs and they can fly.
pairs.leftUz: Ularning pati, ikkita qanoti va ikkita oyog'i bor. Tuxum qo'yadi va ucha oladi.
pairs.whyUz: PAT — faqat qushlarda. Hasharotda ham qanot bor, lekin pat yo'q va oyog'i olti.

exercises.instructionEn: Label the animals using the words below.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ZLAR: dolphin, snake, penguin, cow, butterfly, parrot,
         lion, fly, duck, crocodile, ladybird

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a fly ....... chivin, pashsha (hasharot)
  a ladybird .. xonqizi (qizil, qora nuqtali hasharot)
  a duck ...... o'rdak

DIQQAT: 'a fly' (pashsha — OT) va 'to fly' (uchmoq — FE'L)
bir xil yoziladi, lekin turli so'z turkumi.

answers.descEn: Picture 1 — a large reptile lying on the ground with a long body and short legs
answers.descUz: 1-rasm: yerda yotgan, uzun tanali va kalta oyoqli yirik sudralib yuruvchi

answers.descUz: 2-rasm: suvda suzayotgan, to'q rangli boshli suv qushi

answers.descEn: Picture 3 — a grey sea mammal with a long nose and a smiling mouth
answers.descUz: 3-rasm: uzun tumshuqli va tabassumli og'izli kulrang dengiz sutemizuvchisi

answers.descEn: Picture 4 — a black and white bird standing upright on a rock
answers.descUz: 4-rasm: tosh ustida tik turgan qora-oq qush

answers.descEn: Picture 5 — a small round insect with spots on its back
answers.descUz: 5-rasm: orqasida nuqtalari bor kichik dumaloq hasharot

answers.descEn: Picture 6 — a bird with a curved beak and a very long tail sitting on a branch
answers.descUz: 6-rasm: egri tumshuqli va juda uzun dumli, shoxda o'tirgan qush

answers.descEn: Picture 7 — a small insect with two transparent wings and big eyes
answers.descUz: 7-rasm: ikkita shaffof qanotli va katta ko'zli kichik hasharot

answers.descEn: Picture 8 — a long reptile with no legs, lying in a curve
answers.descUz: 8-rasm: oyog'i yo'q, egilib yotgan uzun sudralib yuruvchi

answers.descEn: Picture 9 — an insect with four large patterned wings
Picture 10 — a large black and white farm animal that gives milk
answers.descUz: 10-rasm: sut beradigan katta qora-oq uy hayvoni

answers.descEn: Picture 11 — a large golden cat with a dark mane around its head
answers.descUz: 11-rasm: boshi atrofida to'q rangli yeli bor katta oltinrang mushuksimon hayvon

wordFormation.introUz: 24-bet — hayvon guruhlari va bir xil yoziladigan so'zlar.

groups.ruleUz: Bir xil yoziladi, turli so'z turkumi
groups.explanationUz: Ingliz tilida bir so'z ham ot, ham fe'l bo'lishi mumkin.
Ikki so'z qo'shilib yangi ot yasaydi.
Har bir guruhning aniq belgisi bor.
'be' dan keyin SIFAT, fe'ldan keyin RAVISH.

patterns.exampleEn: Dolphins have got fins. Elephants have got a trunk.
patterns.exampleUz: Delfinlarda suzgich bor. Fillarda xartum bor.
patterns.explanationUz: Ko'plik ega → HAVE got. Birlik ega → HAS got.

patterns.formula: X lay eggs. / X have babies and feed their young on milk.
patterns.exampleEn: Birds and reptiles both lay eggs. Mammals have babies.
patterns.exampleUz: Qushlar ham, sudralib yuruvchilar ham tuxum qo'yadi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'both' = ikkalasi ham; egadan keyin, fe'ldan oldin turadi.

patterns.formula: X can learn how to + fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: Dolphins can easily learn how to play games.
patterns.exampleUz: Delfinlar o'yin o'ynashni oson o'rgana oladi.

patterns.formula: They are small creatures. They have got + belgi.
patterns.exampleEn: They are small creatures. They have got six legs.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular kichik jonzotlar. Oltita oyog'i bor.
patterns.explanationUz: Ta'rif berish qolipi: avval turi, keyin belgilari.
